description: AgreeDisagree - Present a statement about {topic} and discuss who agrees or disagrees

actions.action_goal: {"id": "agree_disagree_{topic_id}", "description": "Present a statement about {topic}, ask who agrees or disagrees, and facilitate discussion about their reasons.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} presents the statement: {statement}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "{robot_name} asks who agrees and who disagrees.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "At least one participant shares their opinion.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c4", "description": "{robot_name} continues facilitating the discussion for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c5", "description": "{robot_name} summarizes the key points from the discussion.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole.", "Stay neutral - don't judge opinions."]}

statement.description: The statement to agree or disagree with (e.g., 'Cats are better pets than dogs')
statement.example: Cats are better pets than dogs

discussion_time.description: How long to continue the discussion (e.g., '2 minutes', '90 seconds')
